method: Uniform L0 graph harmonic weights transferred through stored L2 subdivision stencils; three-joint linear blend skinning of the preserved evaluated rest surface.

anchors.pelvis: Every L0 vertex outside both socket/ringA/ringB/exit sets
anchors.unknown: Both socket and ringA sets; solve graph harmonic weights without painting

joint_frame: Origin J; Y=normalize(J-K); X=normalize(global+X projected perpendicular to Y); Z=X cross Y. Columns X,Y,Z form rest rotation. Positive flexion uses local RotX(-angle). Pose=Mrest*RotX(-angle); skin=Pose*inverse(Mrest). Pelvis root is identity.
J_role: The two calibration joint reference points become independent experimental hip pivots for this probe only. They control inverse-bind and pose transforms, not resting skin construction; anatomical uncertainty remains.
landmark_roles: T and K have distinct fixed joint-local rest positions, carried by joint pose. Estimated crest/ASIS/PSIS/pubis markers remain pelvis-frame diagnostic points; trochanter is carried with its thigh for illustration, not an implemented bone or anatomical validation.

pivot_counterfactual.role: One causality diagnostic per body, not input tuning or a candidate improvement. Rest vertices remain unchanged. Export the response; do not adopt shifted J.

views.motion: Optional straightforward animation using the declared poses only; no additional pose-search campaign

normalization: L is mean left/right J-to-K rest distance for this body; points are metres. No per-case metric thresholds.

checks.topology: Identical quad arrays and welded index connectivity; finite vertices. No remeshing, welded repairs, caps or disconnected surfaces.
checks.extent: Every represented distal thigh-port vertex follows its joint rigidly, preserving port shape and its rest relationship to T/K, including the stationary leg. K beyond the open surface is not a missing-skin failure.
checks.closed_volume: Not applicable: open neck/arm/thigh boundaries. Do not infer global volume preservation from local area or port checks.

visual_rejection: Obvious separation or sharp attachment seam
Gross collapse, new pinching or interpenetration in the transition
Unexpected upper-pelvis drag or stationary-leg deformation beyond the intended shared transition
Shortening or distortion of the represented distal thigh ends
A presentation that hides defects or shows overlays in place of the actual posed surface
interpretation: Small-angle baseline binding test, not complete anatomy, full-body rig or production architecture acceptance. An LBS/harmonic-weight failure does not by itself reject the fixed surface or topology. Passing mechanical checks is necessary, not sufficient for the visual checkpoint.
stop: At the first meaningful directly inspected regional visual checkpoint, return to Ben via Overseer. If the one baseline fails, close it honestly and send discriminating evidence plus a bounded next-step recommendation to Overseer before any method/shape/topology follow-up. No open-ended tuning. No publication, push, merge, body expansion, general rig or physics work.
